Please Read <3 This could help you be accountable. There are a lot of comments saying you shouldn’t have to pay but at the end of the day running an app isn’t free the same way your phone service isn’t, yet we all need it. 

No you don’t need this app to connect w God, yet we are so beyond blessed to have a God we can develop a relationship w just by seeking Him & talking to Him & reading His word (which is free to do)! 

BUT. Just because we can do it for free doesn’t mean that we actually do. More often than not the 1st thing we do is give attention to the things of the world before we even thank Him for allowing us to wake up. I’m more than guilty of that myself & when finding this app I didn’t think twice knowing I want to do better. 

This app is to help your accountability w/ the Lord & help you ensure you give Him the first moment of your day. The relationship part & the connecting part & the learning part is on you to form. 

Before you say paying $40 to be accountable to your relationship w God is ridiculous. Is therapy that does the same for your other relationships free? Is buying a study bible on Amazon free? God gave us the world to live off of and care for yet your groceries & home aren’t free?? The cost of those coffees in the morning for work or that gym membership you’re not using is equivalent to the cost of a YEAR for an app to help your accountability. That’s nothing compared to all the other things you may buy that you don’t even need or be left behind when you go anyway. 

Stop making excuses or expecting a consumerism world to offer you a free service/good & focus on doing your part to grow w the only One who can save you from this world. Your soul depends on it, don’t overthink it… 

God bless xoxo

$32 A Month????. I rarely if not ever write a review for anything but I felt like I should for this. First I think this app could be very useful and helpful for anyone that wants to grow closer to God and further away for social media and the distractions that come from it. But second, asking someone to pay/subscribe for an app isn’t brand new or out of the norm these days, but paying $7.99 A WEEK is really expensive. That’s roughly $32 A MONTH and $384 A YEAR!!! That’s outrageous for something that’s supposedly to help people to get closer to God. In my personal opinion, it should be free, you shouldn’t take money from people if you honestly want to bring people closer to God. But I completely understand that apps cost money to make and maintain, so I wouldn’t be mad at a price/subscription, but $7.99 A WEEK is outrageous.
